page.overview:
Who is Ice Drone?

The Ice Drone, also known as Ogel agent, Ogel Drone, and Ogel Minion, is an Alpha Team minifigure introduced in 2004.

The Ice Drone wears a uniform that is derived from the previous Skeleton Drone uniform, but with some notable differences. The torso, left arm, and left leg are black, while the rest of the uniform is dark red. The torso is printed with the shape of a scarab. The Ice Drone has a white Mini Head No. 190 skull and wears a transparent fluorescent blue Insect Helm.

Ice Drones are Skeleton Drones that appear exclusively in Mission Deep Freeze, acting as Ogel's minions in piloting Snow Crawlers and spreading Ice Orbs across the globe.

Compared to the stiff and emotionless Skeleton Drones in previous Alpha Team comics, these Ice Drones show some individual personality in their humorous dialogue. In LEGO Magazine issue 5.04, two Ice Drones spell out Vladek's name in a manner reminiscent of cheerleaders, and one Ice Drone empathizes with Ogel's disappointment that Cool Creations are not used to take over the world. In the Adventures mini-comic in LEGO Magazine September/October 2005, Ogel berates his Ice Drones for leaving an Ice Orb in Morcia.
